description: This file defines the LoanSummaryDataProvider interface, which declares methods for computing interest amounts, assembling loan summary data, and filtering based on processing strategies related to loan accounts in the Fineract project.

classes.name: LoanSummaryDataProvider
classes.description: Interface defining methods for calculating and assembling loan summary data, including interest calculations and transaction summaries, for loan accounts.

methods.name: computeTotalUnpaidPayableDueInterestAmount
methods.description: Calculates total unpaid interest that is payable but not due on the specified loan schedule periods as of the given business date.

methods.name: computeTotalUnpaidPayableNotDueInterestAmountOnActualPeriod
methods.description: Computes the total unpaid interest amount that is payable but not due, for a specific loan and period, considering current currency and total unpaid interest.

methods.name: withOnlyCurrencyData
methods.description: Returns a LoanSummaryData object populated with only the specified currency data.

methods.name: withTransactionAmountsSummary
methods.description: Assembles a LoanSummaryData object including transaction amounts for a given loan ID, default summary, repayment schedule, and transaction balances.

methods.name: withTransactionAmountsSummary
methods.description: Overloaded method to assemble a LoanSummaryData object including transaction amounts based directly on a Loan object.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines if this data provider accepts a specific loan processing strategy code.
